name: Hot Tip
summary: A risqué poker variant where your seventh card is stuck to your forehead and Jacks trigger wild cards and slaps.
rules_text: Use one 52-card deck plus 2 jokers for up to 4 players, two decks for more. Jokers are Jacks, never wild. Deal 6 cards face-down plus a 7th face-down head card that you stick to your forehead without looking; others can see it. If any head card is Jack/Joker its owner is slapped and dealer flips a wild card (Jacks/Jokers cannot be wild, reflip). New wilds replace old; only one at a time. Players then look at their 6 cards. If you hold King+Queen together you must discard both and receive 1 face-down baby card; this can happen up to twice. You may draw up to 3 cards, up to two times, with betting rounds before, between and after. Holding a Jack/Joker you may expose it face-up to force a new wild card and be slapped. At showdown reveal your head card and make the best 5-card hand from your 7 cards. Five of a kind beats all; natural hand beats same hand made with wilds.
